separation_rule: Signal and staking are separate columns and are never combined into one rank. Signal = proper score against a benchmark with an interval. Staking = realised return, which is blank because no price source exists. A lucky staking run therefore cannot raise a signal rank, and it cannot be bought: reward_payable is 'no' unless every gate passes.

strategies.name: Singles shadow baseline — team-strength totals
strategies.definition: Fair total = (off_home+def_away)/2 + (off_away+def_home)/2, quoted half a point away from the estimate.
strategies.blocking_gate: G1 sample floor 300 graded games (have 116); G2 no official price for CLV
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: A game-cluster bootstrap lower bound above zero on total MAE improvement over 300+ graded games, and a Brier skill interval above zero on both the ratio and the difference measure. If either interval crosses zero again at n>=300, the model is retired rather than tuned.

strategies.name: Singles shadow baseline — moneyline
strategies.definition: P(home) = Phi(fair_margin / (sqrt(2) sigma)) with sigma from settled markets.
strategies.blocking_gate: G1 sample floor 300 graded games (have 116); the Brier intervals exclude zero at this n, but a gate is a conjunction and G1 is not met
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: A Brier-skill interval that excludes zero against the 'always home' baseline, with the multiplicity adjustment for the number of strategies tested. A point estimate alone is explicitly not enough.

strategies.name: Two-leg parlay of the two singles
strategies.definition: Multiply the two marginal probabilities. Published only to show why that is invalid.
strategies.blocking_gate: G6 joint-evidence gate: no directly validated joint probability exists
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: A validated joint probability for the pair (same game, same side class) with a game-cluster interval, plus the operator's void/push rules. Without both, the combo cannot be ranked at all.

strategies.name: Player-prop combo
strategies.definition: Any combination of player prop legs.
strategies.blocking_gate: G7: no official per-game player logs or prop lines are captured, so no prop variance exists
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: An official per-game log for the props in scope, an official or contractually permitted price source, and a joint model validated out of sample.

strategies.name: Availability-conditional total (injury feature)
strategies.definition: The S1 total with a pre-kickoff availability feature added.
strategies.blocking_gate: G7 ablation gate: a fixed injury penalty is forbidden by the brief, and the ablation needs multi-week dated availability history; this repo holds one week
strategies.what_would_change_our_mind: An A/B ablation: identical models with and without verified availability features, on chronological holdouts, with the difference reported with uncertainty. A fixed points penalty is rejected outright.

controls.name: Always pick the home team
controls.note: probability 1.0 on home; the floor any model must beat

controls.name: Running league-average total
controls.note: the naive total; S1 must beat this, not the market, to earn a second look

controls.name: Random pick at p=0.5
controls.note: closed-form Brier of a coin flip, published so a 0.24 model is not mistaken for skill

source_note: every row cites an official domain or states why no value exists
